statement: For degree 2n−3 hypersurfaces in Pn with n≥4, the generic geometric monodromy on the D_n lines is the full symmetric group S_(D_n). Hashimoto–Kadets explicitly recall Harris’s computation of monodromy of lines on hypersurfaces of degree greater than three.

answer.text: For degree 2n−3 hypersurfaces in Pn with n≥4, the generic geometric monodromy on the D_n lines is the full symmetric group S_(D_n). Hashimoto–Kadets explicitly recall Harris’s computation of monodromy of lines on hypersurfaces of degree greater than three.

source.location: Introduction, paragraph immediately after Theorem 1.2, PDF p.2; cites Harris [Har79], §III.1

scope: Generic degree d=2n−3 hypersurfaces in complex Pn, n≥4; monodromy over the unrestricted coefficient family.
notes: This exact line-hypersurface result is stronger than the article’s general alternating-or-symmetric theorem for higher-dimensional linear spaces. The inspected source is Hashimoto–Kadets; Harris’s original §III.1 full text was not accessible in this pass. The generic cubic and degree-one cases are supplied separately.
